WITH source_runs AS (SELECT ? AS run_id UNION SELECT run_id FROM task_conversation_turns WHERE tenant=? AND task_id=?),
            linked AS (SELECT r.rowid AS position,r.id,origin.id AS source_run_id,COALESCE(origin_turn.number,1) AS source_turn
            FROM runs r JOIN runs origin ON origin.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND origin.id=json_extract(r.state,'$.task.source_run_id')
            LEFT JOIN task_conversation_turns origin_turn ON origin_turn.tenant=r.tenant_id AND origin_turn.run_id=origin.id
            LEFT JOIN task_conversation_turns member ON member.tenant=r.tenant_id AND member.run_id=r.id
            LEFT JOIN task_conversations c ON c.tenant=r.tenant_id AND c.id=r.id
            WHERE r.tenant_id=? AND json_extract(r.state,'$.task.project_id')=? AND json_extract(r.state,'$.task.principal')=?
            AND json_valid(r.state)
            AND json_extract(r.state,'$.task.source_run_id') IS NOT NULL
            AND json_extract(r.state,'$.task.source_run_id') IN (SELECT run_id FROM source_runs)
            AND COALESCE(json_extract(r.state,'$.task.conversation_context.turn'),1)=1 AND (member.number IS NULL OR member.number=1)
            AND (c.id IS NULL OR (c.workspace=? AND c.project=? AND c.principal=?))
            AND json_extract(origin.state,'$.task.project_id')=? AND json_extract(origin.state,'$.task.principal')=?
            AND COALESCE(origin_turn.task_id,origin.id)=? AND r.id!=?) SELECT position,id FROM linked ORDER BY position DESC LIMIT 1

SEARCH task_conversation_turns USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_task_conversation_turns_2 (tenant=? AND task_id=?)
SEARCH origin USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_runs_1 (tenant_id=? AND id=?)
SEARCH origin_turn USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_task_conversation_turns_3 (tenant=? AND run_id=?) LEFT-JOIN
SEARCH member USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_task_conversation_turns_3 (tenant=? AND run_id=?) LEFT-JOIN
SEARCH c USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_task_conversations_1 (tenant=? AND id=?) LEFT-JOIN

WITH targets(id) AS (VALUES (?),(?),(?),(?))
            SELECT COALESCE(t.task_id,r.id) AS task_id,COALESCE(t.number,1) AS turn,
            r.id,r.version,json_extract(r.state,'$.status') AS status,
            json_extract(r.state,'$.cleanup_failure') AS failure
            FROM runs r LEFT JOIN task_conversation_turns t ON t.tenant=r.tenant_id AND t.run_id=r.id
            WHERE r.tenant_id=? AND r.id IN (SELECT id FROM targets UNION
                SELECT child.run_id FROM task_conversation_turns child JOIN targets ON child.task_id=targets.id WHERE child.tenant=?)
            AND json_type(r.state,'$.cleanup_failure')='object' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM task_cleanup_reviews review WHERE review.tenant=r.tenant_id AND review.run_id=r.id AND review.run_version=r.version) ORDER BY t.number,r.id
